binary_policy: ZIPs/model binaries, NPY outputs and NPZ fixtures are stat-classified only. NPZ is separate because some split/moment fixtures may be useful nonweights. No binary was opened, copied, moved, removed, or staged.
limitations: NUL-delimited status and lstat metadata only; no file contents were opened.
Candidate path list is a review aid, not staging authorization.
Large JSON/JSONL metadata, sensitive-name paths, provider/terminal raw directories, source checkouts and binaries are omitted from candidate path list and require separate root review.
This reflects Main HEAD and worktree at one time only; root cleanup/final drain may change it.
